instructions:
Follow these steps:
1. flat sheet of paper [CLM-04]
2. folded rectangular paper [CLM-05]
3. partially folded fan-like pattern [CLM-06]
4. diamond base shape [CLM-07]
5. flattened complex folded base [CLM-08]
6. elongated diamond structure with pockets [CLM-09]
7. narrow flattened strip shape [CLM-10]
8. forming head and tail sections [CLM-11]
9. completed origami crane [CLM-12]
10. Upload your attempt as: video, image.
title: Practice: Fold a Paper Crane
